Day 2 at Titiwangsa ✨ 
So many lovely little moments today. ❤️

A little more colour, a little more sparkle, and so many lovely moments today. 💛

From trying on bracelets to discovering new charms and handmade pieces, we’re so happy to see everyone enjoying the Bless4Happy booth.

Thank you to everyone who stopped by, browsed, tried something on, had a chat with us, or brought a little piece of happiness home.

We’ll be here again at:

📍 Mini GMBB • FBM 2026
📍 Laman 1, Titiwangsa
📅 11–13 September 2026

Come explore our handmade bracelets, earrings, necklaces, natural stones, pearls, charms and customisable pieces.

See you at Titiwangsa. 🤍
